coverage_assessment: Documented open-web first pass with 38 logged searches: weekly January searches in German, French, Italian and English; regional, policy and sector checks; and December/February boundary checks. Eighty source cards are retained. No Romansh-specific search or LexisNexis/equivalent closed-news-archive review was performed. Search-engine noise, blocked/search-only sources and local-language/rural coverage limits mean this is not exhaustive. Official MM baseline and additional Coding Procedure remain coordinator-controlled and unresolved.
